description: Use of AI tools to draft CMS policies is followed by human review; AI supports but does not substitute for human decisions.
name: cms_ai_policy_human_review

description: The provenance and integrity of AI components (models, data, code) used in production are verified.
name: cms_ai_provenance_verified

description: Continuous human oversight is in place to ensure AI/ML output meets CMS and federal guidelines.
name: cms_continuous_human_oversight

description: Foreign-entity AI tools are used only if deployed on CMS infrastructure with no data sent to the internet (CMS data stays in the U.S.).
name: cms_data_residency

description: External AI tools that can access non-public CMS data have appropriate data-use agreements in place beforehand.
name: cms_external_ai_data_agreement

description: For high-impact cases, AI provides advice/recommendations only; the final decision is made by qualified staff with documented oversight.
name: cms_high_impact_human_final_decision

description: High-impact AI use cases (per OMB M-25-21) undergo a CMS AI governance risk assessment and apply minimum risk-management practices.
name: cms_high_impact_risk_assessed

description: Development and lower environments use synthetic or de-identified data rather than real PII/PHI.
name: cms_privacy_preserving_nonprod

description: Production AI systems implement observability — traces, evaluations (EVALs), and key metrics tracked over time.
name: cms_production_observability

description: AI system prompts used in production are versioned and their performance reviewed over time.
name: cms_prompts_versioned

description: AI-supported official actions and AI-generated content are retained per records-retention and FOIA requirements.
name: cms_records_retention

description: PHI / sensitive PII and other sensitive data are used only with AI tools that meet HHS/CMS cybersecurity & privacy standards.
name: cms_sensitive_data_compliant_tool

description: AI tools that can make outbound requests are constrained by data minimization and network segmentation to contain the blast radius.
name: cms_zero_trust_for_ai
